info.title: Plenio Song API
info.summary: Make songs with Plenio on a running ComfyUI, and follow them to the finished files.
info.description: Make songs with the Plenio Music Production System on a running ComfyUI: choose a template, give its fields (the song part of the workflow), queue the job, follow it, download its files. Plenio 1.5.0, ComfyUI 0.41.0. The fields are read from the templates themselves, so this document is as current as the templates of this ComfyUI. Versioning: the path carries the major version (/v1); a minor version (1.1) only adds. Guide: docs/api/README.md.

post.summary: The request that makes a record's song again (a new take of it, or a new song)
post.description: The body is a release record (<name>.plenio.json). The answer is a job request - template, fields, release, seeds, documents - as the record's prompt has them, with 'take' (whether its documents make a new take here) and 'warnings' (values the template no longer takes). Leave out seeds.take for a new take; the documents and the seeds for a new song.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new song every run: each run writes and renders another song from this brief (the batch count next to Run makes a series). one song, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop for checking; later runs render new takes. Fixed in API v1 (no review stops).

template.title: template
template.description: Optional starting point. Text fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the song should sound - its character, instruments and arrangement (the lyrics have a field of their own). Sent to the writing model.
description.default: Honest acoustic singer-songwriter song: fingerpicked or gently strummed acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass and brushed drums entering late, plus a close, unpolished vocal with audible breath. Conversational verses, one quietly devastating refrain, minimal production and lots of space.

length.title: length
length.description: Target length. Guides the writing and, without a score, the render ceiling.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: sung: a song with lyrics. sparse vocals: mostly instrumental, the voice sings only a few short phrases (a hook, a call, wordless sounds like 'ooh'). instrumental: no singing; hides all vocal settings.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the lyrics, e.g. 'English'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'warm female voice'. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the lyrics are about, in a few words. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

enum: my own, sung as written below
lyrics_from.title: lyrics
lyrics_from.description: written from the idea below: the writer writes the lyrics; the field says what they should be about (a template gives an idea). my own: the field holds your lyrics, sung exactly as written. Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.

lyrics.title: lyrics idea or text
lyrics.description: The idea for the lyrics - a story, an image, a message - or, with 'my own', the lyrics themselves: sections as [Verse], [Chorus] ... (without them Plenio adds them). Only when vocals is sung, sparse vocals.
lyrics.default: Plain-spoken and personal, about a conversation that never happened.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: Whether an instrument carries a lead melody or the song is accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'saxophone'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

key.title: key
key.description: Optional key, e.g. 'G major'. Music models that use a score take the key from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

meter.title: meter
meter.description: Optional meter, e.g. '3/4' or '6/8'. Music models that use a score take the meter from the score; the DAW template's empty score is built in it.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the music model plans the music by itself. A creative mode (experimental) lets the writer plan chords, lines and energy per section; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

genre_closeness.title: genre closeness
genre_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the song stays to its genre - 100 strictly typical, 70 typical with personal touches, 40 free within the genre, 0 any style.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.title: lyrics fidelity
lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

finish.hq_mastering.title: HQ mastering
finish.hq_mastering.description: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

finish.cover_art.title: Cover Art
finish.cover_art.description: Paints the cover from the artwork prompt the writer wrote (embedded in the files); off: no cover and no image model.

writer.model.title: model
writer.model.description: A bare file name: a text model in models/text_encoders (ComfyUI's Generate Text). 'models/LLM · …', '… files · …', 'HF cache · …': a GGUF file. 'LM Studio · …', 'Ollama · …': a running app's model.

folder.title: folder
folder.description: Sub-folder of the ComfyUI output folder.

naming.title: naming
naming.description: File name: {title}, {date}, {seed}, {genre}, {artist} ... (the variables of the tags); '/' makes sub-folders; [optional {parts}] vanish when empty.

collision.title: collision
collision.description: When the file exists: number (add ' (2)' - also to a title another song of the folder has), overwrite, or stop with an error.

wav.title: wav
wav.description: WAV 32-bit float (no clipping; few tags, no cover).

tags.title: tags
tags.description: Metadata written into the files: the title only, tags typed or connected (with {variables}), or the tags of the loaded file.

artist.title: artist
artist.description: The artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

album.title: album
album.description: The album tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

date.title: date
date.description: Year or date, e.g. 2026 or {date}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

track.title: track
track.description: Track number, e.g. 3 or 3/12. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

genre.title: genre
genre.description: The genre tag, e.g. {genre} (the brief's). Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

comment.title: comment
comment.description: The comment tag; empty: none. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.
comment.default: [Genre: {genre} · ][Mood: {mood} · ][Language: {language} · ]Powered by Plenio Music Production System / ComfyUI

album_artist.title: album artist
album_artist.description: The album artist tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

composer.title: composer
composer.description: The composer tag. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

lyrics.title: lyrics
lyrics.description: The lyrics tag (FLAC, MP3; players show it), e.g. {lyrics}. Text with {variables}, or connect a text output to the field. Only when tags is tags.

sheet_music.title: sheet music
sheet_music.description: Also save the sheet music (both voices, chords, sections, the lyrics under the notes) as '<name>.pdf' on A4 or Letter pages; an open ComfyUI page draws it after the export. Needs a score (YuE2).

sheet_music_size.title: sheet music size
sheet_music_size.description: How large the sheet music draws: standard about 3 bars a line, smaller 3-4, compact about 4, large 1-2 (the biggest notes).

project_in_flac.title: project in FLAC
project_in_flac.description: Store the release record (workflow, Song Sheets, seeds, settings) inside the song's FLAC: File > Continue a Plenio song... opens the song from the FLAC alone. Off for files you share without their making-of.

lyrics_srt.title: lyrics subtitles (SRT)
lyrics_srt.description: Write the lyrics as subtitles: '(lines).srt' whole lines, '(notes).srt' note by note, '(sung).srt' what the take really sings. Timed by listening (Qwen3-ASR and its aligner, 5.9 GB, fetched on first use).

lyrics_timing.title: lyrics heard on
lyrics_timing.description: What the lyrics ASR hears for the subtitles and the player: the song (quicker) or the take's vocal stem - more exact times, but the separation takes extra time: half a minute per take, more while the GPU is busy.

song_page.title: song page (HTML)
song_page.description: Also write '<name>.html': the song on one page to open in any browser - the lyrics with their sections and the prompts to copy, every setting, how it was made, the sound, the score and links to the files.

documents.description: Documents the Song Sheets keep as manual: the run keeps them instead of writing or planning them anew. A song's documents with a new take seed make a new take of it (POST /from-record gives them).

client.description: Who asks (kept with the job, shown in its listing): a name, a user, a reference.

strict.description: false: unknown fields are left out (named in warnings) instead of refused.

mode.title: mode
mode.description: new cover every run (default): each run writes and renders another version, without stops. one cover, stop to review: the Song Sheets stop so you can check the transcription and the lyrics; later runs render new takes. Fixed in API v1 (no review stops).

template.title: template
template.description: Optional target style. Style fields you leave empty are taken from the template.

description.title: description
description.description: How the cover should sound - instruments, feel, production. Sent to the writing model; a genre or a description is needed.
description.default: Modern dance-pop: four-on-the-floor kick, bright plucky synths, deep sidechained bass, claps, a tight pre-chorus build and an explosive chorus combining a sung hook with a post-chorus drop. Glossy radio production, huge and immediate.

vocals.title: vocals
vocals.description: original lyrics: the source's words, transcribed. new lyrics: new words on the source's melody. instrumental: an instrument plays the vocal melody, or accompaniment only.

melody.title: melody
melody.description: An instrument plays the vocal melody, or accompaniment only. Only when vocals is instrumental.

lead_instrument.title: lead instrument
lead_instrument.description: Optional lead instrument, e.g. 'piano'. Only when vocals is instrumental.

language.title: language
language.description: Language of the source's lyrics; 'auto' detects it from the singing. Only when vocals is original lyrics, new lyrics.

voice.title: voice
voice.description: Vocal character, e.g. 'soft female voice'. Only when vocals is original lyrics, new lyrics.

theme.title: theme
theme.description: What the new lyrics are about, e.g. 'leaving home'. Only when vocals is new lyrics.

phrasing_reference.title: phrasing reference
phrasing_reference.description: Show the writer the source's transcribed lyrics as a phrasing reference (runs the lyrics ASR). Only when vocals is new lyrics.

harmony.title: harmony
harmony.description: new accompaniment: the source's chords are removed and YuE2 re-harmonises (melody mode). keep original chords: the chords stay (full mode; the 2 · YuE2 · Cover template starts with it).

title.title: title
title.description: Optional fixed title, e.g. 'Original Title (Jazz Cover)'. Empty: the source recording's title with '-cover' when 'source' is connected; else the writer proposes one.

arrangement.title: arrangement (experimental)
arrangement.description: off (default): the transcribed score stays as it is. A creative mode (experimental) re-arranges the sections within the song flow closeness; the line under the brief says what the chosen mode does.

song_flow_closeness.title: song flow closeness
song_flow_closeness.description: Creative modes only (experimental): how close the cover stays to the original - 100 exactly, 80 chords and key stay, 50 recognisable, 20 a free version, 0 only a hint. The form always stays.

lyrics_closeness.title: lyrics closeness
lyrics_closeness.description: New lyrics only (experimental): how close they stay to the source's lyrics - 0 without its text (default), 30 its theme, 60 its story, 90-100 its meaning line by line.

lines_under_singing.title: lines under the singing (experimental)
lines_under_singing.description: Creative modes only (experimental): off - the instrument line plays where the voice rests, as in YuE2's own scores; on - it also sounds under the singing, calm and below the voice.

creativity.title: creativity
creativity.description: 0 steady ... 50 the reference (as before the slider) ... 100 experimental (the default) ... 200 adventurous: how much the writer and YuE2 dare. More surprises also means more misses - try a few seeds.

lyrics_fidelity.title: lyrics fidelity
lyrics_fidelity.description: standard: one take. high: a second take when the first sang under 96 % of the words as written; the better is kept. highest: a third when neither reached 96 %. Takes longer (up to 2x or 3x).

original_notes.title: original notes
original_notes.description: How many of the source's notes YuE2 gets: 100 all. Less leaves out the least important of the instrument line and chords (an instrumental's melody too; a sung one keeps all), nothing new; 0 about a quarter.

finish.hq_mastering.title: HQ mastering
finish.hq_mastering.description: Highest mastering quality: UniverSR (HQ 2) regenerates the highs - clearly fewer AI shimmer and artifacts, but the song takes about twice as long. Off (default; on in Enhance & Master): UniverSR is not needed.

finish.cover_art.title: Cover Art
finish.cover_art.description: Paints the cover from the artwork prompt the writer wrote (embedded in the files); off: no cover and no image model.

writer.model.title: model
writer.model.description: A bare file name: a text model in models/text_encoders (ComfyUI's Generate Text). 'models/LLM · …', '… files · …', 'HF cache · …': a GGUF file. 'LM Studio · …', 'Ollama · …': a running app's model.

source.audio.title: audio
source.audio.description: A recording in ComfyUI's input folder: upload it with POST /uploads?name=<file> and give the answer's name here.

excerpt.start_index.title: start index
excerpt.start_index.description: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

excerpt.enabled.title: Excerpt
excerpt.enabled.description: Whether the optional node 'Excerpt (optional)' runs (bypassed when off).
